title: David Theophine — draw on sand, pull to let the waves wash it away
note: A WebGL shader experiment: draw on a sand surface, then pull to let waves roll in and wash the drawing away. The erase is the interaction — not a button or an undo, but a tide. She had already commented on it: Your brain is magical. Her steal: a Play-page sand-drawing canvas where visitors draw her motifs and pull to wash them clean, and the wash-away as a reset mechanic generally.
